description: Source code for managing a whitelist of origin domains in WebKit, including parsing JSON data, requesting whitelist info from WPEFramework, and adding whitelist entries to WebKit.

classes.name: JSONEntry
classes.description: Represents a JSON object for origin-domain pair with subdomain flag, used for parsing whitelist JSON data.

methods.name: ParseWhiteList
methods.description: Parses JSON string containing whitelist data and populates the internal whitelist map.

methods.name: WhiteListedOriginDomainsList::RequestFromWPEFramework
methods.description: Requests whitelist data from WPEFramework via synchronous message and returns a populated whitelist object.

methods.name: WhiteListedOriginDomainsList::AddWhiteListToWebKit
methods.description: Adds the stored whitelist entries to WebKit as origin access whitelist entries.
